## Ghoul Hound Companion (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
 NE Small undead  
 **Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +6  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 15, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 13 (3d8)  
 **Fort** +1, **Ref** +3, **Will** +4  
 **Immune** undead traits  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 20 ft.; four-footed run (40 ft.)  
 **Melee** bite +4 (1d4+1 plus feed), 2 claws -1 (1d3)  
 **Special Attacks** diseased pustules, feed (5 hp)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 13, **Dex** 15, Con—, **Int** 10, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 11  
 **Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 14 (18 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Combat Reflexes, Dodge  
 **Skills** Climb +7, Perception +7, Stealth +12, Survival +4  
 **Languages** understands Common  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Diseased Pustules (Ex)** When a ghoul hound companion takes damage from a piercing or slashing weapon, some of its boils rupture, squirting the attacker with puslike fluids. The noxious secretions act as *stinking cloud*, except they only target that creature. The effect lasts 1d4 rounds.  
 
 **Feed (Su)** Every time a ghoul hound makes a successful bite attack, it feeds on its opponent’s flesh and gains 5 temporary hit points. The festrog cannot have more than 5 temporary hit points gained by this ability at one time.  
 
 **Four-Footed Run (Ex)** A ghoul hound companion can run on all fours at speed of 40 feet if it doesn’t hold or carry anything in its hands. When running on all fours, it is treated as if it had the Run feat.
